mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user (username, password, email, phone, nickname, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{nickname}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, email, phone, nickname, status, created_at, updated_at FROM t_user ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_user SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, phone = #{phone}, nickname = #{nickname}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
